_comment: PRODUCTION realm template — import ONCE, then manage in the Keycloak admin console. Access model: ADMIN-ONLY (registrationAllowed=false) so only an admin authorizes users; no email verification (verifyEmail=false) so no SMTP is required. Before use you MUST: (1) replace app.example.com with your real frontend origin, (2) enable MFA/OTP for the browser flow (Authentication -> browser -> require OTP), (3) create confidential M2M clients per-consumer (none are shipped here), (4) run Keycloak with start --optimized + KC_DB=postgres behind TLS. To later allow self-signup or email verification, set registrationAllowed/verifyEmail true and configure SMTP. See docs/AUTH-KEYCLOAK.md.
passwordPolicy: length(12) and upperCase(1) and lowerCase(1) and digits(1) and specialChars(1) and notUsername(undefined) and passwordHistory(3)
